comments.author: newvegasmatt
comments.body_html:
I really do love this mod. Great work!
I particularly enjoy the 700 Nitro!
Is there any chance you could make an extra round for it.

The 45-70 has a copper extreme penetrator round available for it, I thought it would be funny to have that in a 700 nitro! I don’t see it in real life, but then again nobody is developing AP rounds for 10-20 guns. (That’s the estimated number of 700 nitro’s in existence from one source I saw)

My thought is that it would have a lot of penetration, like 50+, as the 45-70 version almost triples or quadruples the penetration in gel, and also increases hard target penetration significantly. But it would have less damage as a result, Like 250-300 or so. I also thought it could have less of a chance to cause a heavy bleed, but like 95% for a light bleed since it tends to bore through targets. Higher velocity, lower recoil, lighter overall, more accurate, more expensive, you get the idea.

Lookup the underwood ammo extreme penetrator round for the 45-70, thats the idea I’m going for.
You can watch videos with the 44 magnum and 357 version of the rounds doing work. the screwdriver head creates crazy cavitation without deforming the bullet.

Anyways, thanks for the great mod!
